title: codonoboea koerperi
intro: Codonoboea koerperi, commonly known as the Malay cat's whisker, is a type of flowering plant native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Codonoboea koerperi include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. Bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
